title: A Mountain-Pass Algorithm for Nonlocal Problems with Super-quadratic Nonlinearities
summary: In this paper we consider a nonlinear equation $-\mathcal{L} u(x) = f(x, u(x))$ with a super-quadratic nonlinearity, $f$, and a nonlocal operator, $\mathcal{L}$, generated by a special class of radially symmetric $L^1$ convolution kernels with finite second moments. The assumptions on this operator are mild and allow for a variety of kernels used in biological and physical applications, including kernels with algebraic decay and sign changing kernels.
